releases.name: AlDente 1.39.4
releases.body:
## AlDente 1.39.4 Coralli

### Free

- Fixed visual glitches in the Popover that occurred in the first betas of macOS 27.2.

### Pro

- Fixed unintended behavior in Calibration Mode when it was triggered by macOS.
- Fixed the “Stop Charging When App Closed” setting for users running macOS 26 or macOS 15.
- Fixed an issue that caused Sailing Mode to not work properly on macOS 26 and macOS 15.

## AlDente 1.39.3

### Pro

- Fixed some issues with Calibration Mode on devices with macOS 26 and macOS 15.

## AlDente 1.39.2

### All

- Fixed an issue that caused the charge limit to not work properly on some Intel MacBooks running certain macOS versions.
- Charge limits below 80% are now available again on Intel MacBooks without requiring an additional toggle.
- Several smaller improvements.

## AlDente 1.39.1

### All

- Fixed a bug that caused the charge limit to not work properly on some MacBooks with macOS 15 and below.

## AlDente 1.39

### All

- Completely rebuilt charge control with macOS 27 support and improved reliability on earlier macOS versions and Intel MacBooks, including after downgrading from the macOS 27 beta.
- Charge limits below 80% now require enabling a toggle in Charge Settings for the best experience with Apple’s new charge control systems.
- Reduced AlDente’s impact on WindowServer CPU usage.
- General stability improvements and bug fixes.

### Pro

- Calibration Mode now automatically detects and integrates Apple’s battery calibration. After the initial charging phase, you can cancel or let AlDente complete the calibration for an even better result.
- Redesigned the Apps Using Significant Energy widget with Quit buttons, optional background processes, and improved app detection.
- Hardware battery percentage is now available in the stats widget and menu bar items catalog. Removed the previous toggle; charge control now always uses the macOS percentage.
- Fixed scheduled task start times resetting when changing the repeat interval.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.name: AlDente 1.38.1
releases.body:
## AlDente 1.38.1 Fusilli

### For macOS 27 Beta users:
- We released a first beta of AlDente with support for the macOS 27 beta.
- To receive this beta, enable the "Receive Beta Updates" toggle in the AlDente settings.


### Pro

- Fixed the system load value on the MacBook Pro 15 inch 2016.
- Fixed disappearing of all menu bar items when only main battery icon was set to "Don't Show".
- Fixed ⁠iOS battery icon CoreGraphics bug.
- Fixed the message input scroll on the Help page.
- Fixed the message preserving when navigating away.
- Improved the Compose Email hint.


## AlDente 1.38 

### All

- Implemented a "What's New" window for release highlights.
- Implemented a Help & Support page with direct contact and resources.
- Improved the Onboarding layout and elements style.
- Added missing hover popups on some controls and status icons for better clarity.
- Added a confirmation dialog after pressing the Reset Settings button.
- Fixed the popover window not opening after rapid menubar clicks. 
- Fixed the overcharge notification not clearing when the charge drops to the limit.
- Fixed Automatic Updates not matching the setting.
- Fixed Accessability issue with "Increase contrast" enabled.
- Removed the Optimized Battery Charging step in Onboarding for Tahoe.
- AlDente now requires macOS 12.0 as the minimum OS version has been increased by Apple.

### Pro
- Reimplemented the Power Flow diagram from scratch with a significantly reduced CPU footprint (macOS 26+).
- Added new SoC, USB, and Display power readings to the Power Flow diagram (macOS 26+).
- Added a dedicated, expandable Power Flow panel to the dashboard.
- Added a new Onboarding step for the popover style with live preview.
- Added a new Onboarding step for menu bar style.
- Added Schedule Templates for easier setup.
- Implemented SetLowPowerMode and SetHighPowerMode Apple shortcuts.
- Enabled advanced sleep settings for Intel MacBooks.
- Improved Schedule Task card layout.
- Improved the style of Topup/Discharge buttons when activated.
- Improved the notification when graphs are loading to clarify the state.
- Fixed battery capacity readings on macOS 27.
- Fixed temperature units in the heat protection slider and status widget.
- Fixed jiggle animation stopping after widget reorder in edit mode.
- Fixed pro settings from survey not being applied if deactivated.
- Fixed compact widget appearing for the High Power Mode.
- Fixed random null values in graphs.
- Fixed Maximum Capacity graph not loading on start in the popover.
- Fixed the delayed charge limit values on the Battery Level graph.
- Integrated a setting to enable AlDente beta updates.

Also check out [Leftovers](https://apphousekitchen.com/leftovers/), our fresh new app!
It lets you clean up your Downloads folder by swiping through files like you’re on a dating app.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.name: AlDente 1.37.3
releases.body:
## AlDente 1.37.3 Rigatoni

### All

- General Stability improvements and fixes.
- Updated/added some translations.
- The app does not close automatically anymore after uninstalling the helper.


## AlDente 1.37.2

### All

- Fixed a bug that caused the app to prompt users to re-install the helper after every restart.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the creation of a debug file while no helper is installed.
- General improvements and fixes.

## AlDente 1.37.1

### All
- Added support for macOS 26.4.
- Added support for the new M5 Pro/Max MacBooks and MacBook Neo.
- Fixed the pop-up window always appearing on start-up despite the disabled setting.
- Fixed a bug that caused an unnecessary animation in the dashboard window upon first startup.
- Fixed the info text being cut-off inside the question mark pop-ups.
- Improved the Polish translation.
- Improved the Traditional Chinese translation.
- General stability improvements.

### Pro
- Fixed multiple pop-up warnings appearing after trying to start or stop charging through the menu bar right click while calibrating.

## AlDente 1.37 

### All

- Added the Swedish language.
- Added the Arabic language.
- Improved support for the M5 MacBook Pro.
- Improved the Helper install and uninstall process.
- Fixed the Apple notifications appearing over the popover on macOS 26.
- Many more fixes and stability improvements.

### Pro

- Added a new Status widget for the popover.
- Added graph widgets to the popover.
- Added notifications in the popover.
- Added a notification for when the external monitor charging error happens.
- Added a notification when the MacBook was overcharged on app launch.
- Added the "Lock Screen when lid closed" setting to the Sleep Behavior.
- Improved the Sleep Behavior settings, providing more clarity.
- Improved the license activation process.
- Improved the Energy Mode widget to make it more intuitive.
- Improved the change email address process.
- Moved some Sleep settings to "Show Advanced Settings" section.
- Fixed invalid email error during activation when the email was inserted with a new line.
- Fixed menubar items "jumping" when values change.
- Fixed the interruption of the Calibration Mode when the charging state was changed through the menubar right click.
- Fixed the freezing bug after frequently changing the charge limit.
- Fixed a bug when Calibration "Hold for" didn't show the time correctly.
- Fixed a bug where Energy Mode Apple Shortcuts were not automatically completed.
- Fixed the charge limit resetting back to normal after the Calibration Mode finishes.
- Fixed the Calibration time resetting back to normal after the Calibration Mode finishes.
- Fixed some Tahoe design issues.
- Fixed resetting the charge limit after the helper was reinstalled.
- Fixed menu bar icon issues when the helper is uninstalled.
- Fixed the missing power plug icon in some areas of AlDente for Intel MacBooks.

Also check out [Leftovers](https://apphousekitchen.com/leftovers/), our fresh new app!
It lets you clean up your Downloads folder by swiping through files like you’re on a dating app.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.body:
## AlDente 1.36.3 Pici

### All

- Fixed a bug that caused some setting toggles not to work in the free version of AlDente.

## AlDente 1.36.2

### All

- Improved translations.

### Pro

- Reduced the menu bar values to one decimal to improve the space efficiency. 
- Fixed the orientation of the Sailing Mode icon in the settings and in the menu bar.
- The Calibration Mode is not automatically interupted anymore when changing the charging state with a menu bar right click.
- Fixed a bug where the Calibration timer was not reset in some scenarios.
- Improved the UI for unavailable settings.

## AlDente 1.36.1

### All

- Fixed a bug that caused the menubar icons to not appear correctly on macOS 13 and older.
- Fixed a bug that caused the dashboard to only appear after a long delay on macOS 11.

### Pro

- Improved the license verification experience.
- Introduced a limit to the schedule history for improved performance and crash prevention.


## AlDente 1.36

### All

- Redesigned the whole app appearance for macOS 26 Tahoe to comply with the latest style guidelines.
- Redesigned the app icon. It can now adapt its appearance on Tahoe based on your macOS preferences.
- Added a "Reduce Transparency" setting for everyone that prefers the older-style glass materials.
- AlDente now remembers the position of the Dashboard after reopening.
- Many more fixes and stability improvements.

### Pro

- Added a new menubar customization setting. You can now completely customize the menubar and add/remove stats.
- Added High Power Mode settings for MacBooks that support the High Power Mode.
- Added a power mode widget for the popover with different display options.
- Added new Apple Shortcuts to enable/disable the Low/High Power Modes.
- Added a message while graphs are collecting data after launching.
- Added a new setting to modify the appearance mode to system/light/dark.
- Added a new "Yearly" interval for scheduled tasks.
- Added a button to clear the scheduled tasks history.
- Added time unit translations.
- Added a timer for Calibration Mode again.
- Moved the "Menubar Right Click" setting to Appearance > Menubar.
- Increased the maximum temperature for Heat Protection.
- Redesigned the scheduled tasks history view and improved the readability.
- Fixed an issue where scheduled tasks do not interrupt the Calibration Mode automatically.
- Fixed different maximum capacity values in the popover and the dashboard.
- Fixed the Low Power Mode tint when the battery percentage is lower than 20%.
- Fixed "iOS Native" menubar icon style to avoid blurriness.
- Fixed a bug with a spinning wheel inside the Quit button.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

- Added a "Reduce Transparency" setting for everyone that prefers the older-style glass materials.
- AlDente now remembers the position of the Dashboard after reopening.
- Many more fixes and stability improvements.

### Pro

- Added a new menubar customization setting. You can now completely customize the menubar and add/remove stats.
- Added High Power Mode settings for MacBooks that support the High Power Mode.
- Added a power mode widget for the popover with different display options.
- Added new Apple Shortcuts to enable/disable the Low/High Power Modes.
- Added a message while graphs are collecting data after launching.
- Added a new setting to modify the appearance mode to system/light/dark.
- Added a new "Yearly" interval for scheduled tasks.
- Added a button to clear the scheduled tasks history.
- Added time unit translations.
- Added a timer for Calibration Mode again.
- Moved the "Menubar Right Click" setting to Appearance > Menubar.
- Increased the maximum temperature for Heat Protection.
- Redesigned the scheduled tasks history view and improved the readability.
- Fixed an issue where scheduled tasks do not interrupt the Calibration Mode automatically.
- Fixed different maximum capacity values in the popover and the dashboard.
- Fixed the Low Power Mode tint when the battery percentage is lower than 20%.
- Fixed "iOS Native" menubar icon style to avoid blurriness.
- Fixed a bug with a spinning wheel inside the Quit button.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.name: AlDente 1.35.1
releases.body:
## AlDente 1.35.1 Spaghetti

### All
- We completely forgot to assign a noodle type to the original 1.35 release. We are incredibly sorry and ashamed about that. This being said, we are proud to announce that this version will be named after a particularly exotic and rare noodle: **Spaghetti**. If you happen to get the chance to try one, we definitely recommend that.
- Improved the UI for the Chinese Simplified Language.
- Many smaller fixes and improvements.

### Pro
- Fixed a bug that caused schedule tasks to be executed many times in a row after executing once.
- Fixed a bug in the Low Power Mode Tint Setting for High Power Mode MacBooks.
- Fixed a bug in the Low Power Mode Setting of AlDente.




## AlDente 1.35

### All
- Full redesign of the settings layout.
- Battery Health Stats and the Battery Cycles graph are now also available for all users using the **free** version of AlDente. Check them out in the AlDente Dashboard.
- Major stability and memory consumption improvements, especially when AlDente has been running fo a long time.
- Fixed brief spike artifacts in Dashboard graphs by smoothing short-interval outliers for a steadier view.
- Many more fixes and improvements.

### Pro
- We’ve added a Power Consumption graph to the Dashboard. You can toggle between Instant usage and Average usage over the last 5, 15, or 30 minutes. There’s also a new Time Remaining estimate that updates in real time, calculated from the selected consumption window and your current charge.
- The charge limit slider is now disabled during Calibration Mode.
- Improved the license activation timeout.
- Added the modification of the charge limit through settings.
- Added an overview of available Apple shortcuts for AlDente.
- Implemented a setting to pause background updates when the AlDente Dashboard window is not in focus.
- Implemented a setting to choose which apps are displayed in the "Apps Using Significant Energy" list, depending on their energy consumption.
- Added a lower limit for the Heat Protection feature to avoid stopping the charging process below 20%.
- The Charge Limit over time is now also included in the Battery Level graph.


With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.name: AlDente 1.34.1
releases.body:
## AlDente 1.34.1

### Pro
- Fixed a bug that caused the Calibration Mode to be interrupted when the display was turned off during the Discharge phases in Clamshell Mode.
- Fixed the Low Power Mode control feature for certain MacBook models.

### All
- Added more options in the setup process.

## AlDente 1.34

### Pro
- Improved the design of the Calibration Mode and added the calibration status to the Dashboard.
- Improved the Calibration Mode algorithm to increase the effectiveness.
- Reduced the CPU load when the Dashboard is open but not in focus.
- Added support for desktop Mac models.
- Improved the appearance and usability of the schedule feature.
- Top Up is now disabled before shutdown to avoid overcharging when logged back in.
- Fixed the visibility of the macOS Capacity for M3 MacBooks.
- Extended the Low Power Mode setting with two more options, "Only On Battery" and "Only on Power Adapter".
- Added two more Actions, "Enable Low Power Mode" and "Disable Low Power Mode" to the Schedule feature.
- Fixed the visibility of Low Power Mode on MacBooks with macOS 13.
- Enabled right click on the menu bar icon with "Ctrl + Left Click" shortcut.

### All
- Support for the new Firmware introduced with the first macOS Tahoe beta. This is not a guarantee that AlDente will work flawlessly on the next macOS beta release. We strongly advise against updating to any beta versions of macOS and waiting for the final release instead.
- Fixed the license activation when the email contains whitespace.
- Updated default settings.
- Many more fixes and improvements.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen

releases.name: [BETA] AlDente 1.33.2
releases.body:
## [BETA] AlDente 1.33.2 Lumache

### All
- Public beta with initial support for macOS Tahoe 26 Developer Beta. Apple made things tricky, but we found a new solution.
- Use with caution, this is an emergency public beta release to support the macOS Tahoe 26 Developer Beta for users who have already updated. Bugs might still be possible.
- This is not a guarantee that AlDente will work flawlessly on the next macOS beta release.
- We strongly advise against updating to any beta versions of macOS and waiting for the final release instead.


## AlDente 1.33.1 Lumache

### All
- Fixed a bug that caused a crash after activating the license on macOS 12 and lower.
- Updated many underlying frameworks and libraries.

## AlDente 1.33

### Pro
- Overhauled Sleep settings for more clarity and macOS native behavior.
- A new setting "Turn display off when inactive" was added to mirror the macOS setting "Turn display off when inactive", while AlDente disables sleep.
- New Menubar Right Click option to open the Dashboard.
- There is a new license management setting with a new option to change the email address within the app.
- Improved usability with in-app help tooltips for better feature explanations.
- Fixed a bug that caused overcharging when the MacBook went to sleep unplugged and was plugged in during sleep.
- Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash when Calibration Mode was closed.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused multiple calibration widgets to appear.

### All
- A new setting, "Share Technical Data", was added in settings/general. This is opt-in only and will enable future insights, new features, and AlDente improvements. You can find more information about this setting on [our new website](https://apphousekitchen.com/new-analytics-setting-in-aldente/)!
- A new uninstall wizard helps you to get rid of all the tiny saucy bits AlDente might leave behind.
- Installation Process improvements.
- Several small improvements and fixes.

With peace & love from Vienna,  
AppHouseKitchen
